concerns.text: FR-001 requires the system to ingest the CTU‑13 dataset. Task T002 introduces a fallback to the NF‑BoT‑IoT‑v3 dataset, which weakens the mandatory requirement and violates the specification.

FR-002 mandates subsampling by retaining the largest weakly connected component (LCC) only. Task T004 adds an extra “top‑degree node selection” step after extracting the LCC, potentially discarding nodes from the LCC and thus weakening the required deterministic subsampling rule.

FR-006 explicitly requires Wilcoxon signed‑rank tests on F1‑scores. Task T008 replaces this with permutation tests, which is a different statistical method and does not satisfy the mandated requirement.

FR-007 demands a ranked list of predictive patterns derived from GNN attributions. Task T009 only produces JSON files of attributions and a distinct‑patterns flag, without providing the required ranked list, thus failing to meet the functional requirement.

Constitution Principle VI requires deterministic subsampling to be explicitly documented, including the random seed used. Task T004 performs deterministic subsampling but does not record the seed in any artifact or config, breaching the reproducibility guarantee.
